verdict.rationale: Azure's REST API documentation says most service APIs have official client libraries that give a native interface to Azure services, so first-party SDKs exist. That is the only evidence: one thin mention, qualified by "most", with no named languages, packages, or SDK documentation. missing for 10: list of supported SDK languages/packages, SDK-specific documentation or quickstarts, coverage across all services, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Most Azure service REST APIs have client libraries that provide a native interface for using Azure services
